caption:
🌡️ Every day of the year, sorted by temperature — 1880 → 2021.

Warming isn't just a higher average: the whole curve moves. In 1950, 15% of days were warmer than the hottest day of 1880. By 1980, 77%. In 2021, 99% 🔥 Watch the bell slide right until 1880's extremes become today's ordinary days.

📊 Data: Berkeley Earth, daily global land-surface temperature (CC BY-NC 4.0). 52,078 daily anomalies against the 1951–1980 average.
